features.name: file_size_kb
features.description: File size in kilobytes.

features.name: has_exif
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether EXIF metadata was present.

features.name: software_editing_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for photo-editing signatures (Photoshop, Canva, GIMP).

features.name: aspect_ratio_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation from standard certificate aspect ratio (1.414).

features.name: ocr_mean_confidence
features.description: Average OCR confidence across all recognized tokens.

features.name: ocr_min_confidence
features.description: Minimum OCR confidence among critical structured fields.

features.name: flagged_field_count
features.description: Count of extracted fields having confidence below threshold 0.70.

features.name: missing_critical_fields_count
features.description: Number of key fields unextracted (name, roll, institution, degree, date).

features.name: baseline_alignment_score
features.description: Text baseline straightness and angle alignment consistency score.

features.name: font_size_consistency_score
features.description: Font size uniformity and line-level height variance consistency score.

features.name: stroke_weight_score
features.description: Stroke Width Transform (SWT) typography consistency score.

features.name: character_spacing_score
features.description: Inter-word and inter-character spacing consistency score.

features.name: logical_consistency_score
features.description: Logical validity (chronology, CGPA scale, institution name) score.

features.name: ela_score
features.description: Error Level Analysis compression uniformity score.

features.name: copy_move_score
features.description: Copy-move clone absence score (1.0 = clean, 0.0 = clone detected).

features.name: cloned_regions_count
features.description: Number of verified duplicate keypoint clone clusters.

features.name: noise_inconsistency_score
features.description: Local noise variance sensor consistency score.

features.name: template_ssim_score
features.description: Masked Structural Similarity Index against registered template.

features.name: template_feature_score
features.description: ORB feature alignment homography inlier ratio.

features.name: seal_match_score
features.description: Emblem cross-correlation and HSV histogram correlation score.

features.name: record_found_flag
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether student record was verified in database.

features.name: record_match_score
features.description: Fuzzy matching score across verified student particulars.
